 Should the Nevada Constitution be amended to create
 an individual’s fundamental right to an abortion, without
 interference by state or local governments, whenever
 the abortion is performed by a qualified healthcare
 professional until fetal viability or when necessary to
 protect the health or life of the pregnant individual at
 any point during the pregnancy?

voters to either present photo identification to verify
their identity when voting in-person or to provide certain
personal information to verify their identity when voting
by mail ballot?

sources.reviewedEvidence: Nevada Secretary of State 2026 General Election Statewide Certified List of Candidates, dated June 25, 2026, 14 pages. Downloaded from Lander County Clerk election information page. Script extracted all 137 certified candidates for four U.S. House districts, six statewide executive offices, eleven state Senate districts, all forty-two Assembly districts, Supreme Court seats B and D, and five Board of Regents districts. Every candidate row retained with its printed party. The official county mirror recovered the certified list after native Secretary of State URLs returned access-challenge HTML.

sources.publisher: Washoe County Registrar of Voters; Nevada Secretary of State booklet
sources.reviewedEvidence: Nevada Secretary of State 2026 Statewide Ballot Questions booklet, 30 pages, downloaded from Washoe County Registrar of Voters. Cover specifies November 3, 2026. The opening page explicitly says there are no statewide questions 1–5 and Questions 6 and 7 return for second voter approval. Script extracted both ballot questions exactly and confirmed matching exact wording in the current official county ballot workbook. The booklet contains the full text of each measure.

Washoe County Registrar of Voters 2026 General Election Contests workbook, linked as the full general-election contest list. Script read XLSX shared strings and cells to recover the current name-on-ballot and party for Veronica Cortes; the certified master file prints that candidate without a delimiter. Both statewide question strings independently matched the official Secretary of State booklet.
